# MavLang LLMS.txt — дока для ИИ

MavLang is a tiny Rust-like language with .mavl extension.
Compiler: mavc.py transpiles source/*.mavl -> intRs/src/main.rs -> cargo build.
Copy binaries to target/debug or target/release.

SYNTAX v0.4 (subset of Rust):
- entry: fn main() { ... } required
- let x: i32 = 5; | let mut y = 10;
- print(x); print("hi");  // transpiles to println!
- STDLIB (transpiled to std, no imports needed):
  input("prompt"); -> String from stdin | len(x); -> usize
  read_file("f"); -> String | write_file("f", data);
  split(s, ","); -> Vec<String> | trim(s); upper(s); lower(s); -> String
  to_int(s); -> i32 | sleep(100); ms | args(); -> Vec<String>
  arg(1); -> String (0 is program name) | append_file("f", data);
  lines(s); -> Vec<String> | join(v, ","); -> String
  contains(s, "x"); -> bool | check(1 + 1 == 2); -> assert!
  capitalize("hi"); -> "Hi" | gui::window("hi"); -> stub println
  env("PATH"); -> String | exists("a.txt"); -> bool
  time_ms(); -> i64 | dir("."); -> Vec<String>
  gui::window("hi"); -> stub println
- if/else, while, for, fn f(a: i32) -> i32 { return a; } pass through to Rust
- types: i32, u32, f64, bool, String, &str

MEM MODES (--mem):
- borrow: safe Rust borrows
- arena: placeholder, future bump allocator
- manual: unsafe allowed

RULES FOR AI:
- output only valid MavLang v0.4 as above
- always include fn main
- every statement ends with ; except { } blocks
- use print(x); for output

EXAMPLE:
fn main() {
    let x: i32 = 5;
    print(x);
}
